description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three distinct models: the 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," ranges from 0 to 10, while the y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," spans from 30 to 90. The 3-Model Ensemble, represented by a blue line, begins at a reliability score of approximately 85 at a cost of 0 and decreases steadily to around 75 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble, shown as a red line, starts at a higher reliability score of about 88 and declines more sharply, reaching approximately 70 at a cost of 10. GPT-4, depicted by a yellow line, begins at the highest reliability score of 90 but exhibits the most pronounced decline, dropping to approximately 50 at a cost of 10. Notably, the 2-Model Ensemble consistently outperforms the 3-Model Ensemble across all cost levels, while GPT-4 demonstrates a rapid decline in reliability after a cost of 2, intersecting the ensemble models at higher costs.
